package scenariorules

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
)

var ErrRule = errors.New("invalid or stale game command")

type Command struct {
	Seq      uint64
	Revision uint64
	Kind     string
	Choice   int
}
type Result struct {
	Revision uint64
	Reward   int
}
type Receipt struct {
	Command Command
	Result  Result
}

// State 是主人的农场，存进主人 PlayerDao.SocialFarm（严格 JSON；挂在已有实体上的状态是那个实体 DAO 的字段）。
// 访客资格来自 friends 模块（主人的好友名单），这里只记每名操作者（主人与各位来过的好友）最后一条回执；
// 回执数以好友上限 + 1 为界。失败由正式 DAO undo 回滚。
type State struct {
	Owner    int64
	Revision uint64
	Last     map[int64]Receipt
	Planted  bool
	ReadyAt  int64
	Harvests int
	Helped   bool
}

// Load 读主人的农场；还没种过（字段为空）时是一块空地。
func Load(raw string, owner int64) (State, error) {
	if owner <= 0 {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	if raw == "" {
		return State{Owner: owner, Last: map[int64]Receipt{}}, nil
	}
	var s State
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader([]byte(raw)))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := d.Decode(&s); err != nil {
		return State{}, err
	}
	if s.Owner != owner || s.Last == nil {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	return s, nil
}

func (s State) Encode() string {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(raw)
}

// Apply 的 friend 由 handler 在同一笔事务里从主人的好友名单得出：主人是 0 号角色，好友访客是 1 号，其余拒绝。
func (s *State) Apply(actor int64, friend bool, cmd Command, now int64) (Result, error) {
	if s.Last == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	index := -1
	switch {
	case actor == s.Owner:
		index = 0
	case friend:
		index = 1
	}
	if index < 0 || cmd.Seq == 0 {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	previous := s.Last[actor]
	if cmd.Seq == previous.Command.Seq {
		if cmd != previous.Command {
			return Result{}, ErrRule
		}
		return previous.Result, nil
	}
	if cmd.Seq != previous.Command.Seq+1 || cmd.Revision != s.Revision {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	reward, err := s.execute(index, cmd, now)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	s.Revision++
	result := Result{Revision: s.Revision, Reward: reward}
	s.Last[actor] = Receipt{Command: cmd, Result: result}
	return result, nil
}

// 主人种植与收获，好友访客帮助一次缩短 10 秒。收益只在收获时领取；访问不延长生产期。
func (s *State) execute(index int, cmd Command, now int64) (int, error) {
	switch cmd.Kind {
	case "plant":
		if index != 0 || s.Planted || cmd.Choice != 0 {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Planted = true
		s.ReadyAt = now + 60000
		s.Helped = false
	case "help":
		if index != 1 || !s.Planted || s.Helped || now >= s.ReadyAt {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Helped = true
		s.ReadyAt -= 10000
	case "harvest":
		if index != 0 || !s.Planted || now < s.ReadyAt {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Planted = false
		s.Harvests++
		return 5, nil
	default:
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	return 0, nil
}
